popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book XI — Agamemnon's aristeia breaks, Diomedes and Odysseus fall wounded, and Ajax holds the wall while Hector presses.

popCulture.title: Diomedes
popCulture.description: The wounded Tydeid who still fights — Paris' arrow and the chiefs' retreat that opens the path to Patroclus.

popCulture.title: Ajax the Great
popCulture.description: The shield that covers the wounded — Telamonian Ajax alone holding the Greek left when the chiefs go down.
